source: Existing IID CCP/PSP samples with integer-embedded secret. No new oracle problem.

local_results.exact_transport: T_(a,L)(y)=(pi/sigma_(a^-1)(pi))^L*sigma_(a^-1)(y). Lowest residue multiplier is a^L, not a.
local_results.Gaussian_admission: Nonzero Gaussian weights available iff gcd(L,p-1)=1. Physical compiler implemented for p3, exact field-matrix controls for p3/5/7.
local_results.source: Low-residue-only selection, invertible transported high parts and independent differences give uniform children on disjoint batches.
local_results.even_level: At p3 even levels all six single-qudit basis permutations have low coefficient1. Counterexample labels1,1 cannot implement formal dependence2,1 by these operations.
local_results.throughput: One-output-per-batch upper consumption ledger (n+1)^(t-1)*S(n,3)^t is still quasi-polynomial when t=Theta(log n); even Gaussian stages alone prevent a polynomial ledger.
local_results.scope: Not a novelty claim, full secret decoder, standard LWE attack, generic merge lower bound or optimal sample lower bound. First RREF free-column failure is not exhaustive kernel rejection.

proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-SOURCE: Prove the native source law and any conditioning, including correlations among multiple surviving registers.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-SECRET: Specify integer embedding versus general ring secrets; retain the full target, not merely its modp digit.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-LEGALITY: Give a public physical compiler without unknown state preparation, inverse, cloning or free coherent oracle access.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-THROUGHPUT: Bound cumulative consumption across L=Theta(log n) levels, final decoding, confidence and digit recursion. A one-output Gaussian primitive is insufficient.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-CLASSICAL: Compare the same access/conditioning model with strongest classical reconstruction and known quantum sieves.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-REVIEW: Obtain independent mathematical review and check literature novelty before accepting a new algorithm claim.

falsifiers: Exact phase transport fails for an allowed integer secret or canonical quotient lift.
Child label is nonuniform after conditioning one measured outcome or selection uses higher label digits.
The proposed output rate ignores correlations, failed outcomes or exponentially rare source filtering.
Total input consumption remains exp(Theta(log^2 n)) despite a locally efficient merge.
A classical algorithm with matching source access or an existing sieve achieves the same claimed asymptotic bound.
next_experiment: Derive the complete native residual state under a multi-output compiler and prove its usable output rate before simulating a scaling advantage.
